name: My Khe beachfront
kicker: Clubs and coffee on the My Khe sand
summary: Spend the evening on the My Khe sand rather than in the lanes. Kalà Kalà Beach Club, at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, is free to enter and runs late, and East West Brewing's taproom faces the water until 01:00. Order a drink, watch the surf go dark, and ask the price before you order.
fee: Kalà Kalà entry is free. Drinks: check on arrival.
getThere: Walk from a My Khe hotel to 51 Vo Nguyen Giap.
heroCaption: People on the sand, with the headland in the haze

notice.title: Ask the price first
notice.body: Neither room posts a drink price. Ask before you order.

body: This is the beach evening: a club and a brewery on the sand, and a coffee when you want a chair facing the water. Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, free to enter and open from 08:00 until late. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom, by the shores of My Khe, pours from 08:00 to 01:00 every day.
The lanes a few streets inland are An Thuong, which is the other night. The swim, the buoys, and the rescue hours belong to the My Khe morning.

figures.caption: The My Khe sand, with the resort line further along the beach
figures.alt: Surf and sand at My Khe, with resort towers along the left of the frame

gettingThere: From a hotel on My Khe, walk to Vo Nguyen Giap. Kalà Kalà is number 51. East West is on the same beachfront, so ask on the sand. From the river, take a Grab.

legs.heading: From a My Khe hotel
legs.body: Walk to 51 Vo Nguyen Giap for Kalà Kalà. East West is on the same beachfront.

legs.heading: From the river
legs.body: By Grab to Vo Nguyen Giap.

hours: Kalà Kalà: 08:00–02:00 (guest guide) or 08:00–midnight (site footer). East West: 08:00–01:00 every day. East West street number: check on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day listed for either room.
